chunks.text: Today we will talk about Cancun.
Cancun is a very famous city in Mexico.
It is a place where many people go for vacation.
Let's learn about Cancun in slow and easy English.
Part 1 Where is Cancun?
Cancun is in the country of Mexico.
Mexico is in North America.
Cancun is in the south of Mexico.
It is on the coast of the Caribbean Sea.
The Caribbean Sea is very blue and very beautiful.
Cancun is in the state of Quintana Roo.
It is on the Yucatan Peninsula.
This area is famous for beaches, nature, and Mayan history.
Part 2 What is Cancun like?
Cancun is a modern city.
It has many hotels, restaurants, and shops.
It is one of the most popular tourist places in the world.
The weather in Cancun is warm all year.
In winter, it is about 25 degrees Celsius.
In summer, it can be 30 degrees or more.
It is sunny, but sometimes it rains a lot.
Many people visit Cancun to enjoy the sun and the sea.
Part 3 A Short History Long ago, the area around Cancun was home to the Maya people.
The Maya built temples, cities, and pyramids.
They were very smart and had their own calendar and writing system.
For many years, the area was quiet and small.
There were only a few villages and fishermen.
In the 1970s, the Mexican government decided to build a big tourist city.
They chose Cancun because of its beautiful beaches.
Soon, hotels and airports were built.
Today, millions of people come to Cancun every year.
Part 4 Nature in Cancun Cancun has amazing nature.
The beaches have soft white sand.
The sea is clear and turquoise.
There are also many cenotes near Cancun.
A cenote is a natural pool of fresh water in the ground.
The Maya used cenotes for water and for ceremonies.
Today, visitors can swim in them.
There are also coral reefs near Cancun.
People can go snorkeling or diving to see colorful fish and sea turtles.
Part 5 Mayan Ruins Near Cancun Near Cancun, there are many old Mayan ruins.
One of the most famous is Chichen Itza.
It is about two hours away from Cancun.
It has a big pyramid called El Castillo.
It is one of the new seven wonders of the world.
There is also Tulum, a city on the coast.
It has stone buildings and a beautiful view of the sea.
When people visit Cancun, they often take trips to these Mayan ruins.
Part 6 Food in Cancun Mexican food is very tasty and Cancun has many delicious dishes.

Some popular foods are tacos, small tortillas with meat, fish or vegetables, guacamole made with avocado, onion and lime, tamales, corn dough filled with meat or cheese wrapped in leaves, ceviche, fresh fish with lime juice, onion and tomato.
People in Cancun also enjoy tropical fruits like mango, pineapple and papaya.
Part 7 Culture and Traditions Cancun is not only about beaches.
It also has a rich culture.
People celebrate Mexican music and dance.
Mariachi bands play traditional songs.
People dance to lively rhythms.
There are also festivals like Dia de los Muertos, Day of the Dead.
On this day, families remember loved ones with flowers, food and candles.
In Cancun, visitors can learn about both modern life and old Mayan traditions.
Part 8 Tourism in Cancun Tourism is very important in Cancun.
Every year, more than 4 million tourists visit.
Visitors stay in the hotel zone, a long area with many hotels and beaches.
They can relax, swim and enjoy the nightlife.
Cancun has clubs, bars and live shows.
Some people also take boat trips to nearby islands like Isla Mujeres and Cozumel.
These islands are perfect for snorkeling and relaxing.
Part 9 Why Do People Love Cancun?
People love Cancun because it has beautiful weather, clear blue water, friendly people, delicious food, rich history and culture.
It is a place where you can relax, learn and have fun.
Part 10 Outro That is all for today.
Now you know many things about Cancun.
It is a city with amazing beaches, old Mayan ruins, delicious food and a fun culture.
Thank you for listening to the next episode.
